title: Bedrock Robotics Deploys Autonomous Excavators
summary: Bedrock Robotics deploys autonomous excavators to active construction job sites to tackle labor shortages using AI-powered heavy machinery.

title: Goodfire Opens AI Interpretability Platform to Public
summary: Goodfire has released its Silico platform, offering mechanistic interpretability tools to help users peer inside and understand AI model behavior.

title: Earthquake Sensors Record Hurricane Infrasound Signals
summary: Researchers found that seismoacoustic earthquake sensors can detect infrasound and mechanical vibrations produced by turbulent hurricane winds.

title: Lane Electronics Offers Compact Connectors for UAVs
summary: Lane Electronics is supplying Weald Electronics compact LM200 connector systems designed to address the evolving unmanned aerial vehicle market.

title: Nvidia Releases Jetson Orin Nano 2 Computer
summary: Nvidia announced the Jetson Orin Nano 2, an entry-level robotics computer delivering twice the inference performance of the previous Super model.

title: Genesis Recognized for Agentic Data Engineering
summary: The Genesis platform, which operates in customer-managed environments and includes AI agent verification tools, was featured in a Gartner report.

title: VolkerRail Finishes Charing Cross Engineering Programme
summary: VolkerRail completed a 22-day engineering programme during a route closure, allowing Charing Cross and Waterloo East stations to reopen.

title: ASIP Begins OSAT Facility Construction in India
summary: ASIP Technologies has started building a new OSAT facility in Visakhapatnam in partnership with Korean firm APACT.

title: SpaceX Unveils Starbase Spaceport in Louisiana
summary: SpaceX has announced plans for Starbase, Louisiana, described as the largest private spaceport globally.

title: CFD Modelling Cuts Network Rail Bridge Scour Costs
summary: Computational fluid dynamics modelling is improving asset assessment accuracy and reducing bridge scour prevention costs for Network Rail.

title: Ingestible Sensor Tracks Core Temperature
summary: MIT engineers have created an ingestible temperature sensor measuring six by four millimeters that can send continuous core body temperature updates.

title: Electra Hybrid Aircraft Moves from Lab to Factory
summary: Electra’s hybrid, fixed-wing aircraft project, originating from an MIT classroom, has arrived at an Ohio factory.

title: WorldSync Improves Robotic World Models
summary: Researchers introduce WorldSync to align action-conditioned generation in robotic world models, improving policy evaluation and robot task success rates.

title: LAWA Architecture Enhances Robot Future Imagination
summary: LAWA uses compact latent actions to enable efficient test-time future imagination in world action models, improving robot control and success rates.

title: Coherent Direct D-MIMO Localization Framework
summary: Researchers present a unified family of Bayesian state-space filters for wideband near-field D-MIMO systems that operate directly on noisy channel observations.

title: Energy-Aware CNF Placement in O-RAN Edges
summary: This research investigates energy-aware joint placement and migration of cloud-native functions in an O-RAN edge cloud to minimize server and transmission energy.

title: Westinghouse Achieves Criticality for eVinci Microreactor
summary: Westinghouse Electric Company successfully completed zero-power criticality testing for its eVinci microreactor in Nevada.

title: Doubly Non-Negative Relaxations for Neural Network Verification
summary: Researchers proposed an eigenvalue maximization procedure to solve tight doubly non-negative program relaxations for verifying deep neural networks.

title: One-Shot Learning from Demonstration for Contact-Rich Tasks
summary: A new learning from demonstration method uses explicitly modeled physical interactions to enable robots to execute complex contact-rich tasks from a single demonstration.

title: New Sub-$1,700 Humanoid Robot Debuts
summary: A San Francisco startup introduced a household humanoid robot priced at under $1,700 to handle chores like laundry and tidying.

title: Fiber Bragg Grating Whiskers for Underwater Robots
summary: Researchers developed bioinspired FBR whiskers with non-uniform tapers to help underwater robots track hydrodynamic trails and detect vortices.

title: GaussianWAM Integrates Geometry and Semantics in World-Action Models
summary: GaussianWAM distills geometric and semantic supervision from 3D Gaussian fields into world-action models to improve robotic manipulation performance.

title: DeepONet-LSTM Operator for PDE Output Feedback Control
summary: A hybrid DeepONet-LSTM neural operator is proposed to approximate causal boundary operators for the output feedback stabilization of reaction diffusion PDEs.

title: Efficient W-/D-Band Power Amplifier in 130 nm SiGe BiCMOS
summary: A wideband power amplifier designed in a 130-nm SiGe BiCMOS process achieves a small-signal gain bandwidth of 71-133 GHz.

title: Ultra-Compact V-Band Power Amplifier Developed in 22nm FD-SOI
summary: Researchers designed a differential V-band power amplifier using EDMOS transistors in 22nm FD-SOI CMOS, achieving high power density and efficiency.

title: NanoAvionics Launches MP42H Microsatellite Bus
summary: Kongsberg NanoAvionics is introducing its Gen-2 MP42 family of modular microsatellite buses designed for optical or SAR imaging missions.

title: Unvoiced Speech Regions Improve Audio Deepfake Detection
summary: A study shows that analyzing unvoiced speech components using a graph attention detection system significantly improves deepfake audio detection accuracy.

title: Dual-Based Weight Selection for Approximate Linear Programming
summary: A new dual-based method avoids separate greedy-action calculations in approximate linear programming, reducing sensitivity to fixed weights and lowering computational costs.

title: Variation-Based Iterative Learning for Robotic Navigation
summary: A novel variation-based planning framework enables efficient motion planning for single robots and swarms by updating commands in an infinite-dimensional function space.

title: Gripper-Aware Vision Language Action Models for Robotics
summary: Researchers introduce MiGA, a multi-gripper dataset, and GVLA, a model that improves robotic manipulation across diverse gripper types and interaction strategies.
